content:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: streaming-gateway latency spike detected. p95=920ms, p99=1.85s over last 5m. Error budget burn > 80%. Paging oncall: @alex @mira.

alex: Ack. I'm oncall. grabbing traces + checking autoscale.

mira: I'm nearby, will follow up on proxy side. Any customer-facing errors? ricardo?

ricardo: Support saw a handful of customers with stalled SSE connections ~ 12:20 UTC. No 5xxs surfaced yet, but clients report long pauses between chunks. Reporting as potential sev3.

sanjay: Seeing backlog on proxy write queues, p99 write latency hitting ~1.2s on region eu-west-1. tcp retransmits elevated.

emily: Throwing up a quick dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/streaming/streaming-gateway?orgId=1

alex: TL;DR hypothesis: client-side backpressure + proxy buffering causing chunking delays, exacerbated by a recent canary that bumped keepalive settings.

mira: I'm rolling back the keepalive canary now on the proxy ASG. deploy-bot: cancel-or-revert canary?

deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by @mira at 12:23 UTC.

alex: While that's happening, please attach the relevant proxy logs for the time window 12:15-12:25. Command I ran:
```bash
# fetch last 1000 lines from proxy pod
kubectl logs -n infra proxy-gw-abc -c proxy --since=15m | tail -n 1000 > /tmp/proxy-tail.log
```

mira: Logs show repeated `write ECONNRESET` from mobile clients and `EAGAIN` on socket write. Also `client_max_buffer_exceeded` warnings.

taylor: We're also seeing increased queue depth on the serving runtime: queue length spikes align with proxy slowwrites. p99 service queue time ~600ms.

alex: Runbook check: Step 1 toggle `streaming.keepalive=off` is done via canary rollback. Step 2 reduce `max_chunk_size` to 32KB on gateway; I will patch and restart a small subset.

sanjay: Pushing patch to a canary pool: `kubectl set env deployment/proxy-gw STREAM_MAX_CHUNK=32768` on 2 pods. Monitoring.

ricardo: Customer note prepared: "We are investigating intermittent streaming pauses for a subset of connections. Engineers are applying mitigations. Will update in 30m." :email:

emily: Adding a temporary routing policy to shift new traffic to the fresher pooled endpoints (region fallback) to relieve helicious nodes. Doing a 10% traffic shift.

mira: Canary rollback completed. Early signals: p95 baseline dropped from 920ms -> 480ms in 60s for the canary cohort. Good sign.

alex: Still seeing some tail events. Next mitigation: enable `accept-backpressure=true` on runtime so that we fail fast rather than buffer indefinitely. Will flip on canary.

taylor: Suggest we also increase socket write timeout to avoid long stalls; set `proxy.write_timeout=8s` from 30s. That will cause earlier client disconnects but protects SLO.

alex: Agreed. Applying `proxy.write_timeout=8s` on remaining pods.

deploy-bot: Config rollout started at 12:31 UTC to 20% of proxy pods.

mira: Observability update: p99 tail latency down to 1.1s after initial rollback + early config changes. Still above SLO but trending.

sanjay: We've also queued a restart for the most backlogged serving workers to clear KV cache pressure; restart done on pool-12.

ricardo: Customer comms update sent to impacted customers at 12:35 UTC. Reply from one large customer saying they throttled and saw better behavior.

alex: Good. For handoff: My shift ends in 30m. I'll prepare a concise handover to @mira with what we've changed, tickets, and suggested next steps.

mira: I'll take oncall after your handoff. Current priority: monitor p99, verify no spike recurrence, follow up on client-side patch requests, and consider temporary rate-limit for streaming endpoints if tail persists.

emily: Creating incident tracker: INC-7892, link: https://incidents/redwood/INC-7892. Logging actions + timeline.

alex: Quick postmortem notes: root cause likely a config mismatch in keepalive semantics + a cohort of clients that do slow reads (mobile). Contributing factor: recent canary changed keepalive behavior.

taylor: For mitigation checklist: 1) Reverted canary (done), 2) Reduced max_chunk_size (in progress), 3) Applied shorter write_timeout (partial rollout), 4) Restarted hot workers (done), 5) Traffic shift to fallback (done).

mira: Will run through a handover doc in 10m and mark oncall transfer in rotations page.

alex: Handoff: transferring to @mira. Leaving notes in INC-7892. If you see p99 > 1.5s escalate to SRE lead @sanjay and call a bridge.

incident-bot: Handoff recorded: oncall transfer from alex -> mira at 12:52 UTC.

ricardo: I'll keep support looped for any customer escalations.

mira: thanks all. Monitoring mode on. updating the thread with any new anomalies.
